name: R9700 ROCm 10.0 LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct BF16 depth-0 prefill
methodology: Protocol deterministic-prime-extend-completions-v1, runner local-llm-speed v1, measured at the OpenAI-completions API endpoint. Mean of 2 repeats after 1 warmup. Concurrency 1, so the figure is per-request, not aggregate. Depth is the primed KV prefix; at depth 0 the whole prompt is computed (actual cached depth 0, recomputed history 0). Prefill is effective follow-up prompt processing: uncached tokens divided by client-observed time to first output. Decode is client-observed generation throughput over the tokens after the first, so TTFT is excluded. KV cache type default, speculative decoding off. Source: local-llm-benchmarks.dev/data/results.json. Run run-14fd9bfce147b605, completed 2026-09-01. Engine llama.cpp 10.0, runtime ROCm 10.0. Container r9700-llama-rocm-10.0. Weights: None file LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct-BF16.gguf, quant BF16. Prompt 2048 tokens, 128 generated, primed depth 0.
notes: execution_label is unset, unlike the Qwen3.8 rows that say 1 GPU or 2 GPUs. A 1.2B BF16 model fits one 32GB card, and the container is r9700-llama-rocm-10.0 rather than the dual-GPU image, so this is read as one card.
